human_review_tasks.prompt: For each preview, decide whether the portrait is identity decoration only and matches its fictional role/family without implying a real institution, person, outcome, or hidden state.
Check for public-figure or identifiable-person resemblance, protected marks, logos, readable text, signatures, and watermarks.
Review anatomy/artifacts, written equivalent, generic fallback, 96px small-size recognition, and grayscale distinction.
Confirm that model identity, immutable revision, license basis, sampler, seed, prompt/settings, and source hash are documented; do not fill missing values from inference.
Only after all prior gates are approved, review a release derivative, release hash, registry entry, credits, and manifest bridge; otherwise retain the generic fallback and exclude the preview.

review_questions: Does each portrait remain a fictional identity decoration rather than a claim about a real person, institution, or actor outcome?
Does each portrait match its role and actor family without relying on hidden state, severity, intent, or policy meaning?
Are public-figure resemblance, protected marks, readable text, watermark, and artifact risks absent or clearly blocking?
Does the written equivalent and generic fallback preserve actor identity meaning when the portrait is unavailable?
Is each portrait recognizable at the 96px target and distinguishable in grayscale without depending on color alone?
Are the model, immutable revision, license basis, sampler, seed, prompt/settings, and source hash sufficient for an approved generation record?
Should this preview remain unreleased, be revised, or proceed to a separately authorized release/legal review?

authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.runtime_authority: Portrait previews are not loaded by the GUI and cannot encode simulation state, actor intent, severity, outcome, or private information.
authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.technical_provenance: Machine records preserve source paths, hashes, prompts, written equivalents, and current missing-field status; the approved local-model registry is the only model-scope authority.
authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.human_authority: Human reviewers and the project owner must decide identity, resemblance, protected marks, accessibility, quality, legal/training-data, release-derivative, registry, and public-release questions.
forbidden_claims: actual model identity, immutable revision, sampler, or seed
authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.no_guessing_rule: Null or not-exposed-by-preview-tool metadata remain null; no value is reconstructed from the image, prompt, hash, or approved-model registry.
